projects.title: SIMF
projects.summary: Internal web platform that monitors budget & financial execution for the Pará State Department of Education. Anchor project — I'm the tech lead and product owner.
projects.problem: Budget and financial execution were tracked across scattered tools, with no single real-time view for the directors who answer for it.
projects.solution: A role-based web platform that reads SIAFE data in real time, with modules for budget execution, settlements, payments and bank accounts — in active use by DFIN and DPPC.
projects.impact: In active production use, serving SAPF. Deployed on an Ubuntu VM (Nginx + PM2) behind internal DNS with SSL.
projects.privateNote: Private gov system — case study only, with fictional-data screenshots. No code or real data is published.

projects.title: Monitor PETE/PEAE
projects.summary: Production system that tracks daily installments paid to municipalities under two state programs — school transport (PETE) and school meals (PEAE).
projects.problem: Tracking lived in two Google Sheets + AppScripts that hid a real failure mode: a second payment order on the same installment went unnoticed.
projects.solution: An end-to-end pipeline from raw SIAFE report to WhatsApp message + PDFs sent to the Secretary, with anomaly detection and an interactive per-municipality dashboard.
projects.impact: Replaced 2 Google Sheets + AppScripts and surfaced anomalies the old system hid, improving correction and reliability.

projects.title: RootLab
projects.summary: Local-first tool that chains Ishikawa → GUT Matrix → 5 Whys → 5W2H into a single, auditable cascade with PDF export. Runs offline in the browser.
projects.problem: Root-cause analysis is usually scattered across disconnected templates, so the reasoning behind a fix is hard to audit.
projects.solution: A cascading flow where each step's output feeds the next — built offline-first with no server. Aimed at quality (ISO 9001 / IATF 16949), production and Scrum teams.
projects.privateNote: Pre-MVP, in active development — co-developed with a colleague (name may change before launch).

projects.title: EcoPredict
projects.summary: AI + sustainability project in the I2A2 "AI for Sustainable Projects — Towards COP 30" program. Top 7 globally, "Outstanding Achievement" (Dec 2025).
projects.problem: Applying ML and sustainability metrics to a real local context — Belém and the Amazon.
projects.solution: Co-led the project as data analyst, building the ML models and sustainability metrics.
projects.privateNote: Course project — recognised as an award highlight; not published.

projects.title: Diárias
projects.summary: Sibling of PETE/PEAE: generates the monthly standardized load file that HR uploads into ERGON, SEDUC's legacy system.
projects.problem: A manual, error-prone monthly export feeding a legacy system.
projects.solution: Automated generation of the standardized ERGON load file.
